data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned 'inconclusive' solely due to an HTTP 400 API error when attempting to audit .SRCINFO. The deepseek model successfully audited .SRCINFO and found it safe. The disagreement is a tool failure, not a difference in security assessment of the code.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic for transient API errors to prevent incomplete audits.

If a non-executable metadata file (like .SRCINFO) fails to audit, the tool should not block a 'safe' verdict if all executable files (PKGBUILD, .install) have been successfully audited and deemed safe.
